{{External|rsc=Adamantite Chain Mail Body|rs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Adamant chainbody |image = [[File:Adamant chainbody.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = A series of connected metal rings. |value = 4800 |weight = 7.711 |exchange = Yes |id = 1111 }} [[File:Adamant chainbody detail.png|120px|left]] '''Adamant chainbody''' is piece of [[armour]] made from [[adamant equipment|adamantite]]. A player can create an adamant chainbody by using an [[adamant bar|adamantite bar]] on an [[anvil]] while a [[hammer]] and 3 adamantite bars are in the player's inventory. A [[Smithing]] level of 81 is required to make an adamant chainbody and doing so will grant the player 187.5 Smithing experience. Level 30 [[Defence]] is required to wear an adamant chainbody. It can also be bought from [[Wayne's Chains]] in south [[Falador]]. One adamant chainbody is required for [[Song of the Elves]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -15 |arange = 0 |dstab = +36 |dslash = +50 |dcrush = +61 |dmagic = -3 |drange = +38 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = body |image = [[File:Adamant chainbody equipped male.png]] |altimage = [[File:Adamant chainbody equipped female.png|150px]] }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 81 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 187.5 |members = No |ticks = 5 |tools = Hammer |facilities = Anvil |mat1 = Adamantite bar |mat1quantity = 3 |output1 = Adamant chainbody }} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Adamant chainbody}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Adamant chainbody}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Adamant chainbody}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 10 April 2006 |update = Rag and Bone Man |change = *The item was graphically updated. *The item's equip model was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 17 – 24 November 2004 |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Adamant chainbody detail (historical, v1).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Adamant chainbody detail (historical, v2).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Adamant chainbody detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Adamant chainbody (historical, v1).png|center]] |[[File:Adamant chainbody (historical, v2).png|center]] |[[File:Adamant chainbody.png|center]] |- |[[File:Adamant chainbody equipped male (historical).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Adamant chainbody equipped male (historical).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Adamant chainbody equipped male.png|center|300x300px]] |- |29 March 2004 –
